items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: the Buddy Rich Big Band, Gary Burton came over

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Oh, you wouldn’t speak to the other side. You’d know by the way you were dressed or, you know, what you were drinking or something. It was crazy. But yeah, any Americans that came to town — the Buddy Rich Big Band, Gary Burton came over, and the Basie Band came over once or twice. But of course, because Australia is so far away if musicians did a tour of Japan, sometimes they’d like go south and include Australia and New Zealand in their package. But we saw a fair bit of good talent, but not as much as…
So did you get to a point where you found a few players on record that you really liked, and then you tried to emulate them, or were you pretty much —
